notes: Statuses describe this workspace. verified means a live response was inspected during implementation. implemented_unverified means code exists without a successful checked response in the saved run.

sources.name: Open-Meteo Forecast API
sources.verification: HTTP 200 on 9 Oct 2026 for latitude 18.5204, longitude 73.8567, three forecast days. Configured with OPEN_METEO_MODE=non_commercial.
sources.limitations: The free API is non-commercial only. Commercial use needs an Open-Meteo API subscription and OPEN_METEO_MODE=commercial with a key.

sources.name: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API
sources.verification: models=era5 daily temperature_2m_max, precipitation_sum and wind_gusts_10m_max returned 10,958 non-null days for 1991-01-01..2020-12-31 at grid 18.5, 73.75 on 9 Oct 2026.
sources.limitations: ERA5 lags real time by about 6 days. models=era5_land returned null daily precipitation and gusts on this route, so ERA5 is used for all variables. 30-year requests are weighted heavily against the free per-minute limit (HTTP 429).

sources.name: ERA5 1991–2020 climatology via Open-Meteo
sources.verification: Fitted for Pune, Mumbai, Delhi and Chennai grid cells by scripts/train-climatology.ts on 9 Oct 2026, with out-of-time validation (train 1991–2010, test 2011–2020). Outputs in data/models/climatology/.
sources.limitations: Reanalysis grid statistics (about 0.25°), not station records at the premises. Empirical return levels come from 30 annual maxima, so the 10-year level is uncertain.

sources.name: Open-Meteo Geocoding
sources.verification: Search for Pune returned Pune, India at 18.51957, 73.85535 on 9 Oct 2026.
sources.limitations: Place candidates require user confirmation. Match quality is place_name_candidate, not rooftop.

sources.name: World Bank CCKP
sources.verification: Documented IND historical climatology route returned HTTP 200 with metadata.status success, but only time key 1995-07. Coverage is partial and is not filled in.
sources.limitations: Projections and climatologies are not weather forecasts.

sources.name: World Bank Global Flood Exposure
sources.verification: Window reads of FloodPop_IND_1050.tif around 18.5204, 73.8567 on 9 October 2026: 22.3% of residents within about 556 m above 0.15 m modelled depth.
sources.limitations: Population exposure for a modelled 1-in-100-year event. Depth-class band labels are inferred and need confirming against the dataset Read Me. CC BY 4.0. Context only; not used as a business flood score.

sources.name: Sentinel-2 L2A via Microsoft Planetary Computer
sources.verification: Scene of 5 October 2026 over Pune: 0% cloud over the 1 km square, NDVI mean 0.158, previous-year NDVI 0.159.
sources.limitations: Land-cover context only. NDVI is not flood probability, damage or loss. Not scored.

sources.name: Open-Meteo Flood API (GloFAS)
sources.verification: Pune river cell: 29 complete years, typical annual peak 1136.63 m3/s, 10-year level 2688.06 m3/s.
sources.limitations: About 5 km river grid; the nearest cell may not be the river beside the site. Context only. Free tier is non-commercial.

sources.name: Open-Meteo Climate API (CMIP6 HighResMIP)
sources.verification: Three models, 2000-2014 against 2036-2050, at the nearest 0.25 degree cell.
sources.limitations: Projections, not forecasts. Heavy requests count as several calls and can hit the free-tier limit. Context only.

sources.name: Sentinel-2 L2A
sources.verification: STAC search returned S2B_MSIL2A_20261005T052659_N0513_R105_T43QCA_20261005T091454 with cloud cover 0.77. Bands were not downloaded, so NDVI remains not_available.
sources.limitations: Catalog discovery is not an analyzed indicator. NDVI is not flood probability or loss.
